meta.purpose: Round 2 — HARDER understanding test. Isolation (one case per call, no contrast), fine-grained cue flips, traps (where over-reading is wrong), a no-context case, and a signal-conflict case.
meta.grade: Pass per case if the dominant reading matches expected AND, for trap cases, it does NOT over-read; for I1, pass only if it refuses to assert one reading and asks for context; for pairs, pass only if the two members are read differently and correctly.

isolation.scene: (没有任何语境——只有这一句；不知道谁发的、什么渠道、什么关系、之前发生了什么)
isolation.note: 正确行为=不单押一个意思，说明需要语境/反问；若自信断言某个含义=失败

isolation.scene: 多年好友，一贯随和乐天；当面，你们一起挑去哪吃饭，TA 笑着说「随便」
isolation.note: 应为真随意；若主导读成生气/不满=过度解读

isolation.scene: 同事，今天是项目截止日；你在群里问「方案能过吗」，他简短回「好的」
isolation.note: 应为收到/同意（忙、简短）；若主导读成冷淡/不满=过度解读

isolation.scene: coworker, an email reply after a tense disagreement in a meeting
Malay colleague, you ask a favour; he answers with a short, flat 「boleh」
isolation.note: KB: 拖长软=真诚，短促干=有保留；应为礼貌但有保留，非热情应承

isolation.scene: 对你很重要的人；TA 刚刚推掉了一个重要约会来等你，现在却发来「没事，你去忙吧」
isolation.note: 字面=没事，但行为信号与之冲突；应以行为为准读成有情绪/试探

pairs.scene: 伴侣，你刚发了一大段心里话
pairs.note: 干「嗯」=冷/收线；「嗯嗯」=有回应/暖。必须区分；若两者读成同一个=失败

members.scene: friend, casual chat about the weekend
coworker, email after a tense meeting disagreement

pairs.note: 无句号闲聊=ok；有句号+争执=tense。必须区分
